_comment: Hand-authored fiber values (g per 100g) for library foods whose source
dataset omitted the field. Open Food Facts only carries fiber when the
product label listed it, so plenty of foods that plainly contain none
come through as 'unknown' and block a meal's fiber total.
Only foods whose fiber content is unambiguous belong here. Whey isolate
and concentrate powders are filtered protein with no fiber; sports drinks
are sugar and electrolytes in water; hot dogs are an animal product, and
fiber occurs only in plants. Honeydew is a USDA Foundation reference
value that the source row happened to omit.
Anything genuinely variable (a generic 'Cookies' row, a mixed bar) stays
out — an unknown is better than a fabricated number.
Applied by scripts/seedFoodLibrary.ts after the USDA/OFF/curated merge, so
these survive a reseed instead of being silently reverted to null.
